documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Elmbrook Systems (fictional).
In this document "ESH" means Elmbrook Systems. Elmbrook Systems reports annual price escalator of 3.6% for FY2025. Elmbrook Systems reports insurance cover of $8.3m for FY2024 on a reported basis under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Elmbrook Logistics subsidiary reports term years of 6 years for FY2025. Elmbrook Systems reports liability cap of $21m for FY2024 on a reported basis.

documents.title: Amendment letter
documents.text:
Amendment letter — Elmbrook Systems (fictional).
Elmbrook Systems reports annual price escalator of 3.607% for FY2025. Elmbrook Systems reports insurance cover of $10.8m for FY2024 on a reported basis under the original agreement. Elmbrook Systems reports annual fee of $0.9m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Elmbrook Systems reports maximum service credit of 23.5% for FY2024.

documents.title: Supplier summary memo
documents.text:
Supplier summary memo — Elmbrook Systems (fictional).
Elmbrook Systems reports term years of 5 years for FY2025. ESH reports liability cap of $24.5m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Elmbrook Systems reports yearly charges of $1.1m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Elmbrook Systems reports maximum service credit of 18.6% for FY2024. "yearly charges" has the same meaning as "annual fee".
